description: Show a prior Sightglass result to the user as an inline card, in hosts that draw cards. Call it once, after the data call that answered the user's question, with that call's resultId. This call returns the stored result without searching again or spending credits. Skip it for empty results. Where the host draws the card, the user already sees every item: do not restate them as a list or a table, write two or three sentences on what stands out. Where no card appears, the user has not seen the items, so summarize the ones that answer the question.

resultId.description: resultId from the Sightglass call whose results answer the user's question, or from its sign-in result.

name: sightglass_show
title: Show Sightglass results
